Shows guard status & battery, quickly start/stop the forwarder

Forward SMS codes, low-battery and power-outage alerts from a backup phone to your IM abroad (Telegram / Feishu / Discord / Slack / Email).

🔒 Fully local
🚫 Zero data collection · no ads
📖 Fully open-source (MIT)

📱 The app on your backup phone listens for events
 ↓ encrypted upload
☁️ Your own Cloudflare Worker formats & dispatches
 ↓
💬 Telegram / Feishu / Discord / Slack / Email

It forwards 5 event types:
📩 SMS 🪫 Low battery ⚡️ Power lost
🔌 Power on 💚 Daily health report

① Cloudflare → Workers & Pages → Create Worker
② Paste the whole worker/index.single.js into the editor and Deploy
③ In Settings → Variables add:
 • AUTH_TOKEN (a long secret you choose)
 • at least one channel, e.g. TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN + TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID
④ Copy the Worker URL (like https://xxx.workers.dev)

💡 New to this? Tap Help (top-right) for full step-by-step instructions and all env vars.

Back in this app, under "① Cloud configuration":

⚡️ Fastest: generate a QR with tools/setup-qr.html on your computer, then tap "📷 Scan to import config" — done!

Or manually:
① Enter the Worker URL and Token (Token must equal AUTH_TOKEN)
② Set a device name (e.g. "Home backup phone")
③ Tap Save, then "📨 Send test message"

✅ If your IM receives the health report instantly, you are all set!
❌ Not received? 401=token mismatch; 400=bad URL; 500=no channel configured.

For 24/7 reliability, under "③ Permissions":
① Grant "Receive SMS"
② Grant "Notifications" (Android 13+)
③ Tap "Disable battery optimization" and choose Allow

⚠️ Important on OEM ROMs: go to System Settings → Apps → this app and enable "Auto-start / unrestricted background" (Xiaomi, Huawei, OPPO, vivo, Samsung, etc.).

Under "② Service control" tap "Start guard".
When the status bar shows 🟢 "Hedwig on guard", it is running:

• While forwarding it briefly shows 🔄 "Forwarding…"
• On failure it shows a ⚠️ warning
• A 💚 daily health report is sent automatically

You can revisit details anytime via Help (top-right). May Hedwig deliver on time!

HedwigSMS is an open-source SMS forwarder: the app on your backup phone listens for SMS/battery/power events and uploads them to your own Cloudflare Worker, which dispatches them to your IM. Full guide below.

1) Cloud: create a Worker on Cloudflare, paste worker/index.single.js and Deploy.
2) In Settings → Variables set AUTH_TOKEN and at least one channel.
3) Copy the Worker URL.
4) In this app enter URL + Token + device name → Save → Send test message.
5) Grant permissions + disable battery optimization → Start guard.

• AUTH_TOKEN (required): access secret, must match the Token in the app.
• TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID: Telegram bot.
• FEISHU_WEBHOOK_URL (+ optional FEISHU_SIGN_SECRET): Feishu custom bot.
• DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL: Discord channel webhook.
• SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: Slack Incoming Webhook.
• CUSTOM_WEBHOOK_URL: generic — Bark / ServerChan / WeCom / DingTalk / n8n.
• RESEND_API_KEY + EMAIL_FROM + EMAIL_TO: email (via Resend).

Configure at least one channel.

• Nothing forwarded? Grant "Receive SMS", disable battery optimization, tap "Start guard", and verify the cloud link with "Send test message".
• Stops after screen off? OEM ROMs need "Auto-start / unrestricted background" allowed separately.
• Test errors? 401=token ≠ AUTH_TOKEN; 400=bad URL; 500=no channel configured in the Worker.
• When is the daily report? 09:00 by default, triggered by an alarm.

• Zero collection: no analytics, no ads, nothing sent to the author.\n• Fully local: SMS goes only to your own Worker; the Worker code is open and auditable.\n• Encrypted storage: URL & Token stored on-device via EncryptedSharedPreferences (AES-256).
HedwigSMS · open-source (MIT)\nAuthor: Haowei Cao · https://chwjh.com\nMulti-channel dispatch design adapted from OpenClaw (MIT).
